title: ServiceAtLocation
description: One service delivered at one place, with the hours that apply there. HSDS models this as a separate join rather than a field on either side, because a service and a location are independent: one office delivers many services, one service runs from many offices, and the opening hours belong to the pairing rather than to either alone.

openingHoursSpecification.description: schema:OpeningHoursSpecification - the hours this service is available at this location, which may differ from the location's own general hours.

appointmentRequired.description: Whether this service must be booked in advance at this location.

description.description: A plain-language note on this specific pairing, when it differs from the service's own description - e.g. a satellite office offering only part of the service.

availableLanguage.description: BCP 47 tags for languages available at this specific location, where they differ from the service's own `availableLanguage`.
